display.purpose: The instance name on the marquee, with the two-layer hard shade.

headline.purpose: Screen titles in the screen frame and first-run step titles.

play.purpose: The word on Play, Stop and Stopping.

title.purpose: Small signage: the About heading, the tabular memory readout.

body.purpose: All running text; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for young and non-native readers.

label.purpose: Field labels, the drawer handle, the title-bar account name.

mono.purpose: The game log, error detail, Java and data-folder paths.

shadows.name: step
shadows.purpose: Hard step under secondary buttons, segments and the selected rail cabinet; amber buttons use --color-dirt.

shadows.name: play
shadows.purpose: Play only: the deep step plus its lit top edge.

shadows.name: recess
shadows.purpose: Inputs, selects, slider track, a checked segment.

shadows.name: t-molding
shadows.purpose: The marquee bezel where it meets the title bar and rail.

shadows.name: marquee-shade
shadows.purpose: Two-layer hard shade on signage over art.

motion.name: press
motion.value: translate 180ms steps(2, end), box-shadow 180ms steps(2, end)
motion.purpose: Press travel onto the step in two 90 ms frames; also the toggle knob and segments.

motion.name: face-hover
motion.purpose: Button face colour change on hover.

motion.name: play-lit
motion.purpose: Play's lit edge breathing toward #fff2c4 while idle.

motion.name: marquee-dim
motion.value: filter 180ms steps(2, end) to brightness(0.5) saturate(0.75)
motion.purpose: The marquee snaps down while a game is preparing or running.

motion.name: attract-drift
motion.value: translateX(-480px) linear infinite; 180s / 140s / 100s / 60s far to near
motion.purpose: Attract-mode parallax at rest; paused when not idle and neutralised under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Play
components.description: The one lit button: amber on a deep dirt step with a lit top edge; presses the full 8px step in two frames.
components.css: .ds-play { width: 17.5rem; min-height: 5.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; color: var(--color-ground, #181410); background: var(--color-amber, #ffc233); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; corner-shape: notch; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 var(--color-dirt, #7a4a2a), inset 0 3px 0 var(--color-amber-hi, #ffd76e); font-family: Bungee, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: translate 180ms steps(2, end), box-shadow 180ms steps(2, end); } .ds-play:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 0 var(--color-dirt, #7a4a2a), inset 0 3px 0 #fff2c4; } .ds-play:active { translate: 0 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--color-dirt, #7a4a2a), inset 0 3px 0 var(--color-amber-hi, #ffd76e); } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber, #ffc233); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single act on a screen: amber face on a dirt step.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; corner-shape: notch; cursor: pointer; transition: translate 180ms steps(2, end), box-shadow 180ms steps(2, end), background-color 120ms linear; } .ds-btn-primary { color: var(--color-ground, #181410); background: var(--color-amber, #ffc233); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--color-dirt, #7a4a2a); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-amber-hi, #ffd76e); } .ds-btn-primary:active { translate: 0 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--color-dirt, #7a4a2a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber, #ffc233); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The default raised control: raised face on a deep dirt step.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--color-ink, #f6f1e7); background: var(--color-raised, #2e261f); border: 0; border-radius: 4px; corner-shape: notch; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--color-dirt-deep, #4e2e19); cursor: pointer; transition: translate 180ms steps(2, end), box-shadow 180ms steps(2, end), background-color 120ms linear; } .ds-btn2:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-raised, #2e261f), white 7%); } .ds-btn2:active, .ds-btn2[aria-disabled='true'] { translate: 0 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--color-dirt-deep, #4e2e19); } .ds-btn2[aria-disabled='true'] { cursor: progress; } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber, #ffc233); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirmation: coral face on a deep dirt step.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--color-ground, #181410); background: var(--color-coral, #ff5a5f); border: 0; border-radius: 4px; corner-shape: notch; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--color-dirt-deep, #4e2e19); cursor: pointer; transition: translate 180ms steps(2, end), box-shadow 180ms steps(2, end); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-coral, #ff5a5f), white 12%); } .ds-btn-danger:active { translate: 0 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--color-dirt-deep, #4e2e19); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber, #ffc233); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Recessed input sunk into the laminate; coral ring when invalid.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #f6f1e7); } .ds-field > span { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; color: var(--color-ink, #f6f1e7); background: var(--color-ground, #181410); border: 0; border-radius: 4px; corner-shape: notch; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-line, #463a2f); font: inherit; caret-color: var(--color-amber, #ffc233); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-dim, #c5b9a8); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber, #ffc233); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-coral, #ff5a5f); }

components.name: Segment
components.description: Single-choice option: raised on its step; the chosen one is pressed into its slot with a lime lamp.
components.css: .ds-segs { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.125rem; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; color: var(--color-ink, #f6f1e7); background: var(--color-raised, #2e261f); border-radius: 4px; corner-shape: notch; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--color-dirt-deep, #4e2e19); cursor: pointer; transition: translate 180ms steps(2, end), box-shadow 180ms steps(2, end); } .ds-seg:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-raised, #2e261f), white 7%); } .ds-seg[data-checked] { gap: 0.5rem; translate: 0 4px; background: var(--color-ground, #181410); box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--color-dirt-deep, #4e2e19), inset 0 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-line, #463a2f); } .ds-seg[data-checked]::before { content: ''; width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-lime, #c9cc2a); } .ds-seg:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber, #ffc233); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Segmented Meter
components.description: Twenty blue blocks in a recessed channel; fills block by block.
components.css: .ds-meter-wrap { width: 16rem; padding: 3px; background: var(--color-ground, #181410); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-meter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(20, 1fr); gap: 3px; height: 0.75rem; } .ds-meter > span { background: var(--color-line, #463a2f); } .ds-meter > span[data-on] { background: var(--color-blue, #2186cb); }

components.name: Rail Cabinet
components.description: An instance in the 72 px rail; the selected one stands on its step with the amber coin-slot light, a lime LED when running.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; width: 4.5rem; padding: 1rem 0; background: var(--color-ground, #181410); } .ds-rail-item { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; background: var(--color-panel, #221c17); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; corner-shape: notch; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: var(--color-raised, #2e261f); } .ds-rail-item[data-selected] { background: var(--color-raised, #2e261f); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--color-dirt-deep, #4e2e19); } .ds-rail-item[data-selected]::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -0.625rem; top: 30%; width: 4px; height: 40%; background: var(--color-amber, #ffc233); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber, #ffc233); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rail-led { position: absolute; right: 0.375rem; bottom: 0.375rem; width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-lime, #c9cc2a); }

components.name: Error Card
components.description: A failure in the player's language: coral warning diamond, message, fix, actions.
components.html:
Minecraft ran out of memory.

Give it more memory in the instance settings and try again.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: flex-start; max-width: 30rem; padding: 1.25rem; color: var(--color-ink, #f6f1e7); background: var(--color-panel, #221c17); border-radius: 6px; corner-shape: notch; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card-icon { flex: none; margin-top: 0.125rem; color: var(--color-coral, #ff5a5f); } .ds-card-msg { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-fix { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: var(--color-ink-dim, #c5b9a8); }

narrative.overview:
Every instance is an arcade cabinet. Its seeded landscape is a backlit marquee, the rail down the left is a row of cabinets with a coin-slot light beside the one you're standing at, and Play is the one lit button you press. The room is warm laminate black, never navy. Controls are physical: they stand on a brown dirt step taken from the PerlandDev land-plot mark, and pressing one drops its face onto that step in two snapped frames. Nothing glows, blurs or eases. Depth is hard offset layers, corners are pixel-notched, and state changes snap.

The density is low and the hierarchy is blunt, because the job is "open, press Play, be in the game" for young, often Spanish-speaking players. Home is almost all marquee art: the instance name is huge at lower left, and Play sits lower right with Mods and the overflow menu as quieter raised controls beside it. Every other screen is a plain 48rem column on the ground under a Bungee title, with sticky action rows. The four plot hues are strictly functional: each owns one meaning, and at rest only Play is lit.

The system rejects the launcher category default of a navy gradient, rounded cards and a glowing blue button. It also stays clear of the PerlandDev Panel's cyan chamfered "Director HUD" look.
keyCharacteristics: Warm laminate-black ground (`ground`, `panel`, `raised`, `line`) with warm off-white ink.
Four plot hues with one job each: amber acts, lime means running or OK, coral means stop or fault, blue means info or progress.
Raised controls stand on a dirt step: hard offset under-layers, never a blurred shadow.
Pixel-notched corners (`corner-shape: notch`) on every control and panel.
Bungee signage display with a two-layer hard shade. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for body text, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for logs and paths.
Motion snaps in `steps()`: 180 ms press travel in two steps, a snapped marquee dim, and a slow attract-mode parallax that stops under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Lit Button Rule
rules.body: At rest, Play is the only lit thing on screen. Amber means "press this to act". Never use it as a decorative accent, a heading colour or a selected-state fill.

rules.name: The Lime Lamp Rule
rules.body: A chosen option shows a small square lime lamp and sits pressed into its slot. Selection never borrows amber, because amber is reserved for acting.

rules.name: The Hue Has One Job Rule
rules.body: Lime is running or OK, coral is stop or fault, blue is info or progress. A status never relies on hue alone, so pair it with a label, an icon or a shape (the LED, the warning diamond, the meter blocks).

rules.name: The Hard Shade Rule
rules.body: Signage over art carries a two-layer hard shade, never a blur: `dirt` offset 0.045em, then `ground` offset 0.09em. The version line under the name sits on a translucent laminate plate, so the art never decides its contrast.

rules.name: The Signage Names, Atkinson Speaks Rule
rules.body: Bungee appears only on names and titles (the instance, the screen, the welcome, Play, a big readout). Sentences, labels, buttons and errors are always Atkinson.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every live number (files, MB, memory, counts) uses tabular figures so readouts don't jitter while they count.

rules.name: The Dirt Step Rule
rules.body: Everything that can be pressed stands on a hard dirt step: `dirt` under amber, `dirt-deep` under everything else. Pressing travels the full step height and removes it. No blur, ever.

rules.name: The Spent Step Rule
rules.body: A control whose action is running stays pressed down. Play while queued or preparing, a button with `aria-disabled="true"` while pending, and a disabled control all sit on their spent step with no under-layer.

dos: **Do** keep Play the only lit control at rest. Amber is for acting: Play, the single primary action on a screen, focus, the caret and the coin-slot light.
**Do** mark a chosen option with the pressed segment and its 8px lime lamp.
**Do** stand every pressable control on a hard dirt step (`0 4px 0`, `6px` large, `8px` for Play and cards), and press it the full step height in `steps(2, end)` over 180 ms.
**Do** keep a pending control pressed with `aria-disabled="true"` so it keeps focus. Reserve `disabled` for unavailable controls.
**Do** notch every corner with `corner-shape: notch` (4px controls, 6px panels).
**Do** recess inputs, toggles, the slider track and the meter channel into `ground` with the 2px dark top edge and 1px `line` ring.
**Do** shade signage over art with the two-layer hard shade (`dirt` 0.045em, `ground` 0.09em), and seat small text on a laminate plate.
**Do** fill progress block by block in blue with tabular counts in real MB.
**Do** pad `main` by the drawer's open height so Play is never covered, and keep primary form actions in a sticky row.
**Do** let attract-mode parallax stop under reduced motion. State changes snap.
donts: **Don't** use blurred box-shadows, glows or soft elevation. Depth is hard offset layers only.
**Don't** fill a selection, a heading or decoration with amber. A lit amber selection makes two lit buttons.
**Don't** use a navy gradient, rounded cards or a glowing blue button, which are the launcher category default this system replaces.
**Don't** ease state changes or animate progress smoothly. Use `steps()` or snap.
**Don't** set sentences, labels or errors in Bungee. Don't set the log or paths in anything but Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono.
**Don't** use any hue as the only carrier of status. Pair it with a label, an icon or a shape.
**Don't** reuse the PerlandDev Panel's cyan chamfered mark or HUD language, Modrinth branding or Mojang artwork. Marquees, plot icons and avatars are generated.
